title: Yamal on Clásico day v Messi, Ronaldo and Mbappé at the same age
checked: Clásico date 25 Oct 2026 at Camp Nou (FC Barcelona + Football España); Yamal born 13 Jul 2007 = 19 years 104 days that day. Figures by each player's 19th birthday (club and country, all competitions): Yamal 182 games 56+64, Messi 43 games 11+6, Ronaldo 55 games 6+7, Mbappé 90 games 39+29, minutes per goal or assist 111/120/217/79 (Planet Football's two age-19 tables, July 2026; one outlet, so framed as their count). After 100 games: Yamal 21+30 at 17y7m, Messi 40+19 at 20y105d, Ronaldo 17+25 at 19y262d, with trophies (90min + Bolavip agree). League-only splits not available, so all-competition numbers are used and said so.

lines.text: On Clásico day, the twenty-fifth of October, Lamine Yamal was nineteen years and one hundred and four days old.
So how does he compare with Messi, Ronaldo and Mbappé at the same age?
By his nineteenth birthday, Yamal had fifty-six goals and sixty-four assists, for club and country.
Now the legends by nineteen. Mbappé sixty-eight goals and assists. Messi seventeen. Ronaldo thirteen.
That's more than Messi and Ronaldo put together. Four times over.
But here's the catch. Yamal played one hundred and eighty-two games. Messi only forty-three.
So let's match the minutes. Per minute on the pitch, Mbappé was the deadliest of the lot.

scene.title: Minutes per goal or assist, by 19

lines.text: And match the games. After one hundred games each, Messi had fifty-nine goals and assists. Yamal fifty-one.
Ronaldo, after a hundred games? Forty-two.
The difference is age. Yamal hit a hundred games at seventeen. Messi was twenty.
And by then Yamal already had La Liga, the Spanish Super Cup and the Euros.
So who wins the age-match? Yamal, Messi, Ronaldo or Mbappé? Tell me in the comments.

scene.text: Ask me again when I'm Messi's age.
